newsitem.title: FINLAND: Calmer Helsinki ticks ahead with Nokia, forestries.
newsitem.headline: Calmer Helsinki ticks ahead with Nokia, forestries.

text.p: Shares rose on Thursday in a quieter session than earlier this week with most of the action back in benchmark Nokia and plenty of attention on Raisio, which briefed investors about its international plans for Benecol.

But the outlook was not entirely sunny, with the market vulnerable to potential international profit-taking and some brokers voicing nerves as the December FOX index future traded at 786.00, up 4.00 but at a discount to the FOX index at 791.59.
"The derivatives market expects the bourse to turn lower," one broker said; although futures activity in Finnish equities can be very thin and an unreliable indicator.
"The Kemira issue was a very good thing," said one broker with no connection to the lead managers. "The pricing was spot on."

The state said at the end of the session it had sold all six million shares in an offering to private investors, and one broker was confident lead managers will exercise an option to issue three million more.
"There is no doubt the extra shares will go," he said.
